meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 通过 DeltaChat 集成加密邮件通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加端到端加密的邮件聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate encrypted email messaging via DeltaChat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add end-to-end encrypted email chat to your app

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 就能通过 DeltaChat（一个基于邮箱的聊天应用）收发消息。消息自带端到端加密，并直接对接 DeltaChat 核心，无需额外桥接。
howto.when: 当你在 DeltaChat 中通过邀请链接或二维码添加机器人并发出第一条消息时，或把机器人拉进群组后任何成员发言或喊到机器人名字时，会触发回复。

say.text: 你好，我通过 DeltaChat 联系你。
say.note: 发送后机器人会接入并回复。
配一张图片发送，可更换机器人的头像。
在群聊里这样喊，机器人会回应。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can send and receive messages through DeltaChat, an email-based chat app. Messages are end-to-end encrypted, and it connects directly to DeltaChat's core without extra bridges.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you add the bot via its invite link or QR code in DeltaChat and send your first message, or when anyone speaks in a group and addresses the bot by name.

say_en.text: Hello, I'm reaching you via DeltaChat.
say_en.note: The bot will connect and reply.
Send with an image to change the bot's avatar.
Calling the name in a group makes the bot respond.
